MARKET_DETAIL.MarketBoundariesDescription: The subject market area is bounded generally by the Bay Terrace / Bayside Gables residential enclave of northeastern Queens, bordered by Little Neck Bay to the north and east, the Cross Island Parkway to the west, and 26th/27th Avenue residential blocks to the south. The neighborhood consists predominantly of detached single-family residences on 61-128' irregular to 80x100' lots, built primarily 1935-1960.

SALES_COMPARISON_APPROACH_DETAIL.SalesComparisonCommentDescription: Three closed sales (Comps 1-3) and one active listing (Comp 4) were used. Comp 4 is a distressed, foreclosure-flagged active listing and was given no meaningful weight, serving only as loose upper-range support. Comp 2 required the smallest net adjustment and was given the most weight. Comps 1 and 3 needed larger GLA and room-count adjustments and were given lesser, comparable weight. The adjusted sale prices of the closed comparables ranged from $1,641,280 to $2,061,320, supporting an indicated value of $1,825,000.

VALUATION_COMMENTARY.ValuationCommentText: Market conditions in the subject's Bay Terrace/Bayside neighborhood have remained stable over the past 12 months. Median sale prices show a modest upward trend consistent with typical seasonal variation. No evidence of oversupply, declining values, or unusual marketing times was noted in the comparable sales search.

The subject was listed for sale via OneKey MLS #984368 on 04/14/2026 (Estate of Hellen Phillips, Probate Listing, listing agent Evangelia Boudourakis/Daniel Gale Sothebys) at an original list price of $1,899,000. The listing was reduced to $1,849,000 and went back on market 08/09/2026 with cumulative/current days on market of 115. The subject entered contract on 08/07/2026 at a purchase price of $1,720,000 (Qin Lin, Purchaser), representing 93.1% of the current list price and 90.6% of the original list price. This list-to-contract discount is consistent with a probate/estate sale and is within the range observed among closed comparables in the immediate market area.
In regards to the adjustments in this comparables section in this report, the appraiser utilized the paired sales analysis as the basis for the adjustments.

C3;kitchen-updated-six to ten years ago;bathrooms-remodeled-eleven to fifteen years ago;upon inspection the subject was functional and appears to have been sufficiently maintained by the owner. The kitchen and bathrooms are original and have not been updated within the last fifteen years. No repairs are required and no physical deficiencies were observed. Overall Subject remains in good condition.

There are no prior sales or transfers of the subject property within the three years preceding the effective date of this appraisal. Per ATTOM/GeoData recorded documents, the subject's last recorded arm's-length sale was on 10/15/1997 to Helen Phillips for $634,000. The current transaction is a probate sale by the Estate of Hellen Phillips, under contract on 08/07/2026 to Qin Lin for $1,720,000.
None of the comparable sales used in this report had a prior sale or transfer within three years.

VALUATION_RECONCILIATION_DETAIL.ValuationReconciliationSummaryCommentDes: The Sales Comparison Approach, supported by three closed sales and one active listing, is given primary weight and indicates a value of $1,825,000. The Cost Approach was developed but given minimal weight due to the subject's age (built 1960) and resulting accrued depreciation, indicating $468,604. The Income Approach was not developed as the subject is an owner-occupied single-family residence not typically purchased for rental income. Based on the reliability and quantity of market data in the Sales Comparison Approach, the final opinion of market value is $1,825,000.
